caption: Particles retained through the pipeline. Raw picks and what is left with the mask alone and with the mask and 2D selection together.
note: Counts are on the full micrograph set of each entry. The three printed rows are three of the five conditions of tab:ablation_res: `baseline` (raw picks), `mask` (mask alone), `both` (mask then 2D selection). There is no `select`-alone and no `fb` row in the paper's table. `cumulative_reduction_pct` is the reduction from the raw picks of the same entry, as printed in parentheses, and is cumulative rather than a per-stage removal rate. The `baseline` and `mask` counts are both import-STAR particle counts, so their difference is exactly what the mask removes; the `both` count is read after extraction and 2D classification, so its difference from `mask` also includes candidates lost at extraction and rejected by 2D classification, and must not be read as the amount 2D selection discarded. Per-stage removal rates are in not_in_paper. `job` is the CryoSPARC job the count is read from. This table carries no resolution, so the EMPIAR-10345 pixel-size caveat does not apply to it.

provenance.source: sec/5_results.tex, tab:particles; docs/notes/5_results.md, headings tab:particles and fig:pick_fates
provenance.detail: Read directly from the CryoSPARC project on 2026-08-17. The baseline and mask rows also appear as particle_counts.import_particles in each condition's metrics.json; the `both` row is read from the select_2D job because it is not in particle_counts.

not_in_paper.note: Two intermediate stages were printed in an earlier version and dropped on 2026-08-17, plus the per-stage removal rates the paper's parentheses do not give. The final select_2D job's parent is the iterated 2D classification of CryoSift, not the first one, so this row counts what passed the selection stage rather than what CryoSift discarded class by class.

per_stage_removal_pct.note: Percent removed relative to the preceding stage, computed on the five-stage version.

select_alone_final_counts.note: The +select condition without the mask in front of it. Not printed in the paper.

fb_condition_stages.note: The same funnel for the fb condition, in the order import / extract / class_2D / select_2D. Not printed in the paper. The notes recorded 10093 as still running at the time they were written; its final select_2D output is 295,644 (ablation.json, main_results.json).
fb_condition_stages.warning: These four numbers come from the earlier LoRA fb arm, which the paper does not report. The full fine-tuning arm the paper reports delivers 127,859 / 295,644 / 27,838 / 208,931.

not_in_paper.abinitio_cap_effect_10532_both: Of the 178,722 particles of the `both` condition on EMPIAR-10532, 176,700 enter ab-initio and 2,022 are unused by all three seeds.
